name: Romanian Grilled Sausages (Mititei)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Combine all ingredients to form a paste.
Shape meat mixture by hand into 7–8 x 2–2.5 cm (3 x 1 inch) sausage shapes. Each should be about 50 g.
Grill the sausages until cooked through. Do not let them dry out.
Serve with salt, mustard, and bread.

culture.text: Mititei or mici (grilled skinless sausages) is a typical Romanian dish. Usually in Romania you can find the prepared meat mixture in most food shops, and you only have to cook them.
